title: Invariant citations resolve to the catalog and overrides respect severity and expiry
statement: Every in-source inv-override annotation MUST carry an invariant id, a reason, a ticket, an expiry, and an approver, MUST name an invariant present in law/invariants/, and an override that is malformed, expired, names an unknown invariant, or names a constitutional or hard-fail invariant MUST be reported as a finding that fails the overrides check; every Inv-Compliance trailer MUST cite only well-formed, catalogued invariant ids, and a required trailer that is absent or empty MUST fail the pr-compliance check.
rationale: Article 11 makes constitutional and hard-fail invariants non-overridable and admits only justified, expiring overrides of the rest; a citation of an id the catalog does not hold claims governance that does not exist.

strategy.rationale: A deterministic test corpus under tests/ and packages/*/tests observes this obligation; trace links the tests.
